Cardiac rehabilitation.recommendation: All ACS patients should participate in a medically supervised, structured, comprehensive, multidisciplinary exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation and prevention programme.

Lifestyle management.recommendation: ACS patients should adopt a healthy lifestyle, including stopping tobacco smoking; Mediterranean-style healthy diet; alcohol restriction; regular aerobic physical activity and resistance exercise; and reduced sedentary time.

Smoking cessation interventions.recommendation: In smokers, offer follow-up support, nicotine replacement therapy, varenicline or bupropion, individually or in combination, should be considered.

Pharmacological treatment - Lipid-loweri.high-dose statin: Recommend initiating or continuing high-dose statin therapy as early as possible, regardless of initial LDL-C values.
Pharmacological treatment - Lipid-loweri.LDL_goal: Aim to achieve LDL-C <1.4 mmol/L (<55 mg/dL) and reduce LDL-C by ≥50% from baseline.
Pharmacological treatment - Lipid-loweri.add_ezetimibe: If LDL-C goal not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin therapy after 4–6 weeks, add ezetimibe.
Pharmacological treatment - Lipid-loweri.add_PCSK9_inhibitor: If LDL-C goal not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin therapy and ezetimibe after 4–6 weeks, add a PCSK9 inhibitor.
Pharmacological treatment - Lipid-loweri.intensify_during_hospitalization: Recommend intensifying lipid-lowering therapy during the index ACS hospitalization for patients who were on lipid-lowering therapy before.

Associated Conditions: Failure to achieve LDL-C goal on maximally tolerated statin plus ezetimibe
genes.context: Text recommends adding a PCSK9 inhibitor if LDL-C goal is not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin therapy and ezetimibe after 4–6 weeks.
